card.text: Small, cratered moon of Saturn with a crater a third its own width.

introduction.text: Mimas is the smallest and innermost of Saturn's major moons, probably made almost entirely of water ice.

normal.title: Monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Source pixels span 216 m in the 2017 mosaic, and shadows in the photographs remain.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color composite
enhanced.summary: Infrared, green and ultraviolet bands show color differences the eye cannot see.

elevation.title: SPC terrain model
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 198.2 km sphere, including Mimas's slightly oval shape.
